question.worked_solution:
First, we multiply both sides of the equation by $3$ to get rid of the fraction:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}\frac{4}{3}x & =8 \\ 3\cdot \frac{4}{3}x & =8\cdot 3 \\ \cancel{3}\cdot \frac{4}{\cancel{3}}x & =8\cdot 3 \\ 4x & =24\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we divide both sides of the equation by $4$ to isolate $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}4x & =24 \\ \frac{4x}{4} & =\frac{24}{4} \\ \frac{\cancel{4}x}{\cancel{4}} & =\frac{24}{4} \\ x & =6\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
